issue: Dark Reader adds root and inline SVG attributes before React hydrates the server HTML

reproduction.method: Playwright CLI Chromium; enable official engine as head becomes available, delay application JavaScript by 500 ms to reproduce pre-hydration injection

change: Move shared icons and brand SVG fill/stroke properties into stylesheets so Dark Reader can theme CSS without adding inline DOM attributes
Tolerate extension-controlled attributes on the html element only; no recursive page suppression, extension opt-out or runtime DOM stripping

checks.check: Web route type generation and TypeScript
Next production build in isolated .next-e2e output directory
Dark Reader quick capture modal opens and Escape closes it without saving records

limitations: Uses the official Dark Reader dynamic engine API in Chromium, not the exact browser extension version installed by the user
Browser extension background/proxy injection is not emulated in full; the root attribute policy covers its reported data-darkreader markers
Docker daemon was unavailable; the updated source was production-built locally, without rebuilding the previously tagged deployment image
data_safety: No personal records created or edited during the extension compatibility check; the regular end-to-end suite uses its isolated database
